audit_items.proof_trace: FFT implementation is in external c-kzg-4844 library (v2.1.1), not Prysm codebase. Prysm's kzg.go wrappers (ComputeCells, RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs) pass inputs directly to ckzg4844 without length validation. Any FFT power-of-2 invariant violations would be library bugs, not Prysm bugs.
